title: The Morose Mononokean
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ashiya, who did not believe in the supernatural, spends his first week of high school in the infirmary because a youkai has attached itself to him, and he asks the morose owner of a small tea room, the Mononokean, for help (Crunchyroll and Manga Up! blurbs via AniList and MU). The owner guides youkai that wander into this world on to the next, and Ashiya ends up working for him, partly to pay off a debt (blurb; MU Debt-Motivated Protagonist). Episodic comedy with an ongoing plot; complete in 18 volumes; adapted to anime (MU).
life_message: Kindness and understanding toward misunderstood beings, and friendship between very different people, bring healing.

content.note: Exorcism and curses (MU); mostly gentle (AniList Iyashikei).
